newsitem.title: MEXICO: VW to invest $500 mln in Mexico plant by 1998.
newsitem.headline: VW to invest $500 mln in Mexico plant by 1998.

text.p: Volkswagen AG said Friday it planned to invest $500 million in its Puebla, Mexico assembly plant over the next two years and expected its suppliers would also invest a similar amount.
Bernd Leissner, president of VW de Mexico, said the money would be spent outfitting the plant to produce Volkswagen's new car to replace the long-selling Beetle.
Leissner made the announcement during a visit to the plant by German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Mexican president Ernesto Zedillo.
During the visit, the two men fixed a commemorative plaque to the 21,300,000th Volkwagen Beetle to be made.
Puebla continues to make the Beetle, production of which long since ceased in Germany.
